rows.en: Let's go. Don't let your guard down.
Don't push yourself.
I'm going in front! Cover my back!
Leave this one to me.
I'm here. Fight without worry.
I'm trusting you with my back.
I'm counting on you in combat, too.
Wake up already, for crying out loud.
Phew, it's over somehow.
Man, that wore me out for nothing.
Looks like it's finally over.
Well, time to pack it in.
Decent enough this time, I guess.
We made it back safe again.
Counting on you next time too.
Flying would be fun if it weren't for the fighting.
Good to hear your voice again.
Hey, want to keep flying a while like this?
With you around, I can fight with peace of mind.
What the hell is this monster?! Why?!
Huh? Oh, yes!
Grab on!
Hurry!
It's okay. You're safe now.
Why are there Vajra in a place like this?
I never thought I'd fight you.
Hedgehog or whatever, once I'm inside it...!
Luca, hold on! I'll be right there!
rows.notes: Line ends on 'sugu' (right away); completed as 'right there'.

rows.en: A song?
Luca! Hang in there! I'll save you right now!
I'm going ahead! Cover me!
That unit... There's no mistake.
I'll be the decoy!
I heard you never miss. Both you and your sister Jessica.
Michael, shoot! Surpass your sister!
rows.notes: Alto says 'Mihail' here; glossary name Michael Blanc.

rows.en: Shoot, Michael! Don't shoot! Shoot, Michael!
rows.notes: Odd order (shoot / don't shoot / shoot) kept as heard.

rows.en: Hmph, nice shot.
I'll be late for class. Let's get going, Michael.
Ranka, you...
Give up! You've lost!
Actor's blood?! Like I care about that! I'm...!
Ranka, why would you go this far?
Ranka, are you okay? Where are you now?
Ranka, I'm coming now. Don't move!
Ranka, hold on! I'll save you right now!
What the hell are you, you monster?!
So that's how you Vajra keep multiplying.
Ranka! I'll definitely save you!
Get out of my way! Ranka's inside that!
She's been taken! On the biggest ship behind you, to the right!
rows.notes: 'She' = Ranka (rows 633, 636); 'you' = the allied pilots he is briefing.

rows.en: It's a Vajra mothership!
I'll deal with this Valkyrie! So please! Save Ranka!
Sheryl.
I can't die in a place like this!
Hang on, Ranka!
Thank goodness you're safe, Sheryl.
What about Ranka?
That ship... Don't tell me Ranka's...
Wait! Ranka's inside it!
Request permission to rescue her!
Roger.
Ranka!
You damn monster!
Michael.
Tease someone about girls in the middle of a mission and you'll get shot down!
Maria!
rows.notes: Transcript 'Mariama'; likely Maria (Fokina?) of this mission; not sure which glossary entry.

rows.en: Why? Why would you...
A woman?! Tch! Is that what an adult says?!
rows.notes: Answers a line about women in 650-651 context; 'onna' kept literal.

rows.en: Sheryl, I'll come back. I'll survive this battle and come back, I swear.
People can't fly alone. They shouldn't. Because I finally understand that.

rows.notes: Transcript 'iei' (yeah) at low confidence; a cheer or shout, left blank.

rows.en: That voice... Could it be...? Ah... somehow...
Why are you doing this? Why try to destroy us? Ranka!
Why did you do that to Ranka?!
Invaders? No! We are...!
I saw it! I saw what it really is!
That's not Ranka! Shoot that fake!
